stem: Meena looks at four places near her home in Kerala and lists the living things she sees in each. Which list best shows the biodiversity of that place?

options.text: A rice field: paddy plants, frogs, dragonflies, egrets and earthworms
A garden: five rose bushes of the same kind
A courtyard: only the stones and bricks lying there
A fish tank: ten goldfish of the same variety

teacher.key_rationale: Biodiversity means the variety of different plants and animals in a region; only option A contains many different kinds of living things with different roles. Options B and D show only one kind of organism, and C lists no living things.
